quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo discusses his aspirations for a future movie career
quotes.excerpt: My first movie will be like Daddy Day Care. Like Eddie Murphy. Or Vin Diesel.
quotes.quote: My first movie will be like Daddy Day Care. Like Eddie Murphy. Have you watched Eddie Murphy? Or Vin Diesel when he was like a spy that had to take care of the kids? He was like a nanny. So you'll start with a comedic one. A funny one. Get inside your home, like you see me. You see me, and you're like, 'Oh, he's funny.' Then I'm gonna do an action movie. Few words. Just action.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo envisions a dramatic role alongside Denzel Washington
quotes.excerpt: Denzel will be like Morgan Freeman in his late 70s. Do a movie just me and him.
quotes.quote: And then I would do drama. Denzel will be like Morgan Freeman in his late 70s. Do a movie just me and him. He's going to guide me through the movie, make me look good. I'm gonna win the Oscar, watch.

quotes.speaker: Dwayne Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Dwayne Johnson on the deceptive stature of NBA players in person
quotes.excerpt: You see him on TV and then you see him in person and how impressive he is.

text_blocks.speaker: Dwayne Johnson
text_blocks.text: You know what happens when you see him in person? He's obviously so massive, but it's that deceptive when you see it on TV and then you see him in person and how impressive he is, just stature-wise. But it reminds me of all the dudes out there who think they could ball in the NBA. And then you look at this guy. We were just saying, can you imagine guarding this on the court? Dudes on the weekend who are playing at the gym.

text_blocks.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: You guys should see like LeBron or like Wembanyama.

quotes.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo names Kevin Durant as the toughest player he's guarded
quotes.excerpt: Toughest player gotta be Kevin Durant. Probably the best scorer of all time.
quotes.quote: Toughest player gotta be Kevin Durant. Kevin Durant, yeah. Just motor, guts, just no talent. That's fake talent. Probably the best scorer of all time. You gotta respect also LeBron, because he's done it so many years. Like when LeBron came to the league, I was nine years old and I'm playing against him.
